name: Tapbound
author: Vivek

sections.description:
An app-style mobile view, no redesign

This plugin gives your site a clean, app-style layout on phones and inside the Tapbound app. Your content and your look stay yours. Your theme is never replaced.

Connect your site to a real app

One click from your WordPress admin opens the Tapbound app creation flow with your site pre-filled. Choose how the app looks, then receive a real Android and iOS app.

Privacy and data

This plugin connects to the Tapbound service (https://tapbound.com). Your site URL is sent to tapbound.com only when you click “Create your app” on the plugin settings page. Nothing is sent at any other time, and nothing is sent to visitors of your site.

External services

This plugin connects to the Tapbound service (https://tapbound.com) to start the mobile app build flow for your site.

  • What the service is used for: Connecting your WordPress site with Tapbound to create native Android and iOS mobile applications.
  • What data is sent and when: When an administrator clicks “Create your app” on the plugin settings page, your WordPress site URL is sent to Tapbound (https://tapbound.com/api/wizard/save-progress) to pre-fill the mobile app wizard with your site address. No site data is sent at any other time, and no visitor data is ever collected, tracked, or transmitted.
  • Service provider: Tapbound (https://tapbound.com)
  • Terms of Service: https://tapbound.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://tapbound.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the tapbound folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install through the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Open Settings, Tapbound to connect your site.
sections.faq:
Does this work without a Tapbound account?

Yes. The app-style mobile view works on its own, with no account and no connection.

What data is sent to Tapbound?

Only your site URL, and only when you click “Create your app” on the settings page. No data is sent to visitors.

Does this replace my theme?

No. The mobile view enhances the rendered page. Your theme stays your theme.

Does this connect my WooCommerce store?

The plugin shows a store section when WooCommerce is active. The store connection itself happens in the Tapbound dashboard, in your app’s Integrations tab.

How do I show my phone or WhatsApp number?

Add your phone or WhatsApp number in Settings, Tapbound. They appear as a floating contact button on your site and in the slide-in menu on the mobile view. You can also put [tapbound_call] or [tapbound_whatsapp] in any post or page.
